MESA MBA C4 | TERM 2 | CASE 3 | INBOUND APPLICATION 1 OF 10
All In Capital — Application Form Response
Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote
them. Pair with the applicant's deck (Application_01_StockSathi_Deck.pptx).
Company
Company name StockSathi (StockSathi Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)
Website www.stocksathi.example
Location Hyderabad, Telangana
Incorporated March 2026
One-line description B2B restocking app with short-term credit for small-town kirana stores.
Sector (as selected) Consumer tech
Stage (as selected) Pre-seed
Team size 4 (2 founders, 2 field agents)
Founders
Founder 1 Aarav Deshmukh, CEO
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/aarav-deshmukh-example
Background: FMCG distribution and field operations, 8 years. Ran a regional
sales team at a large distributor.
Founder 2 Pooja Nair, CTO
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/pooja-nair-example
Background: Software engineer at a payments company, 5 years. Built the
ordering app and our credit-scoring rules.
Time commitment Both full-time since April 2026.
Prior startup experience None for either founder.
Equity split Founders 85%, angels 15%. ESOP pool to be created.
Product and traction
What have you built? A vernacular Android app for store owners to order from partner distributors,
with next-morning delivery and 7 to 14 days credit for repeat customers. Live in
Karimnagar only.

Active customers 42 retailers onboarded, 22 of whom have ordered more than once.
Revenue / GMV GMV of about INR 9 lakh in the last three months. Revenue is trade margin of
about 4% plus a credit fee on credit orders.
Growth GMV has grown every month since the July launch.
Repeat behaviour Repeat customers reorder about once a week.
Customer acquisition Two field agents visit stores and onboard them. Word of mouth between
neighbouring stores has helped. Our CAC is under INR 2,000 per store.
Unit economics Positive contribution on delivered orders once a store has ordered twice.
Credit
How is credit funded? Credit is provided through our NBFC partner. We take the first-loss risk.
Credit book size About INR 85,000 outstanding across 12 retailers.
Defaults to date None so far. We follow up personally on late payments.
Regulatory status Not registered as an NBFC.
Competition and differentiation
Who else is doing this? Large B2B marketplaces and local wholesale markets.
Why will you win? We focus only on small towns and speak the owner's language, literally and in
how we assess credit.
Fundraising
Amount raising INR 2 Cr
Valuation expectation INR 12 Cr post-money
Existing investors Three angels from the FMCG and logistics industry, INR 25 lakh in total.
Use of funds Credit book, hiring, expansion to two more towns.
Other investors in conversation One pre-seed fund. No term sheet yet.
How did you hear about us? Introduction through a founder in your Fund I portfolio.

Anything else we should know?
We have been told our credit-scoring approach is an edge. Happy to walk you through it on a call. We would
also welcome your help with introductions to NBFCs.
